import numpy as np
M=20000.0; f1=1.9; w1=2*np.pi*f1; z1=0.005
k1=w1**2*M; c1=2*z1*np.sqrt(k1*M)
mu=0.04; m=mu*M; f2=f1/(1+mu); w2=2*np.pi*f2
z2=np.sqrt(3*mu/(8*(1+mu))); k2=w2**2*m; c2=2*z2*np.sqrt(k2*m)
def run(c2v):
    dt=0.002; T=15.0; n=int(T/dt)
    x=np.zeros(n); v=np.zeros(n); y=np.zeros(n); w=np.zeros(n)
    x[0]=0.02; v[0]=0.0; y[0]=0.02; w[0]=0.0
    for i in range(n-1):
        Fk=k1*x[i]+c1*(v[i]); Fk2=k2*(x[i]-y[i])+c2v*((v[i]-w[i]))
        a1=(-k1*x[i]-c1*v[i]-k2*(x[i]-y[i])-c2v*(v[i]-w[i]))/M
        a2=(k2*(x[i]-y[i])+c2v*(v[i]-w[i]))/m
        v[i+1]=v[i]+a1*dt; x[i+1]=x[i]+v[i+1]*dt
        w[i+1]=w[i]+a2*dt; y[i+1]=y[i]+w[i+1]*dt
    return x,y
